summary_1line: After Karna’s death the Kaurava army collapses; Shalya is slain, Duryodhana is defeated and hides in a lake, and Dhritarashtra mourns the annihilation of his sons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana, wounded and desperate, slips into the dark waters of a lonely lake while the battlefield smolders behind him.
Bhima leaps from his chariot and whirls his massive iron mace, smashing through thousands of charging foot-soldiers like a storm of destruction.
In the palace hall, blind Dhritarashtra collapses to the floor as Sanjaya announces the death of all his sons while the royal women faint around him.
